description: This file declares the interface for MediaCodecBridge, a class that manages media codec operations on Android, including creating audio/video codecs, handling buffers, and codec events. It also defines related enums, structs, and constants used for media processing.

classes.name: MediaCodecBridge
classes.description: A class that provides an interface to Android's media codec for audio and video decoding, including buffer management and event handling.

classes.name: MediaCodecBridge::Handler
classes.description: An interface for handling media codec events such as errors, buffer availability, format changes, and frame rendering.

methods.name: CreateAudioMediaCodecBridge
methods.description: Factory method to create a media codec bridge for audio streams.

methods.name: CreateVideoMediaCodecBridge
methods.description: Factory method to create a media codec bridge for video streams with various parameters.

methods.name: GetInputBuffer
methods.description: Returns the input buffer jobject for a given index.

methods.name: QueueInputBuffer
methods.description: Queues an input buffer for decoding.

methods.name: QueueSecureInputBuffer
methods.description: Queues a secure input buffer with DRM info.

methods.name: GetOutputBuffer
methods.description: Returns the output buffer jobject for a given index.

methods.name: ReleaseOutputBuffer
methods.description: Releases an output buffer, optionally rendering it.

methods.name: ReleaseOutputBufferAtTimestamp
methods.description: Releases an output buffer at a specific timestamp.

methods.name: SetPlaybackRate
methods.description: Sets the playback rate for the media.

methods.name: OnMediaCodecInputBufferAvailable
methods.description: Handles notification of available input buffer.

methods.name: OnMediaCodecOutputBufferAvailable
methods.description: Handles notification of available output buffer.
